findings.summary: Workflow task links wrap list items, breaking the task list structure exposed to assistive technology.
findings.fix: Make each li a direct child of ul and place the task link inside its li; move the card styling to the link as needed to preserve its click area. Keep the extra-count li as another direct child.
findings.evidence:
Runtime confirmed 2 nodes on 1 pages; axe list, listitem. https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.13/list?application=playwright Selector ['.workflow-tasks']. Runtime 011: axe list and listitem failures on /admin/workflows/list/. Source:
  • ...

findings.summary: The Roles shortcut in user creation and copying is exposed as a tab outside any tablist.
findings.fix: Remove role="tab" from the in-panel shortcut and use a link or native button to activate the Roles panel. In TabsController, write aria-selected only on actual tablist tabs, rather than every trigger; retain aria-controls and move focus appropriately.
findings.evidence: Runtime confirmed 2 nodes on 2 pages; axe aria-required-parent. https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.13/aria-required-parent?application=playwright Selector ['.w-w-fit']. Runtime 044 and 073: aria-required-parent on a.w-w-fit, role="tab" outside tablist. TabsController:186–193 updates aria-selected on all triggerTargets, including this shortcut.

findings.summary: Rich text image and embed preview buttons have no accessible name when a thumbnail is present.
findings.fix: Give MediaBlock an explicit localized accessible label identifying its image/embed and action, supplied by ImageBlock/EmbedBlock (for example “Edit image: [alt text]” or “Edit embed: [title]”). Preserve decorative thumbnail alt="" without relying on it for the button name.
findings.evidence: Runtime confirmed 1 nodes on 1 pages; axe button-name. https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.13/button-name?application=playwright Selector ['.MediaBlock']. Runtime 099 /admin/pages/77/edit/: axe button-name on button.MediaBlock. ImageBlock passes alt=""; EmbedBlock also passes alt="". MediaBlock hides its icon and renders no fallback text when src is present.

findings.summary: The disabled-row style also dims ordinary table metadata to 1.65:1 contrast.
findings.fix: Restrict opacity changes to genuinely inactive controls; keep informational table cell text at 4.5:1. Review disabled chooser/listing rows so unavailable choices do not make their identifying metadata unreadable.
findings.evidence: Runtime confirmed 2 nodes on 1 pages; axe color-contrast. https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.13/color-contrast?application=playwright Selector ['.disabled > td:nth-child(2)']. /admin/styleguide/: .disabled > td:nth-child(2) and td:nth-child(3) contain static "Standard TD", not inactive controls. opacity:.25 yields #c9c9c9 on white (axe1.65:1,12.92px). Inactive choice title is not used as the basis of this finding.

findings.summary: Draftail rich-text textboxes have no accessible name, including fifteen fields on the recipe editor.
findings.fix: Give each visible contenteditable textbox aria-labelledby pointing to its field or block label, or an equivalent translated aria-label; propagate this through Draftail options for both ordinary fields and StreamField widgets.
findings.evidence: Runtime confirmed 26 nodes on 7 pages; axe aria-input-field-name. https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.13/aria-input-field-name?application=playwright Selector ['.notranslate']. Runtime /admin/pages/82/edit/: axe aria-input-field-name finds 15 role=textbox contenteditables without aria-label or aria-labelledby. A label targeting the hidden backing input does not name the visible editor.

findings.summary: Multiple image and document upload file inputs have no accessible name.
findings.fix: Use an associated label for #fileupload in both upload templates; retain the visible “Or choose from your computer” text as the input name. Associate accepted-format and size instructions with aria-describedby.
findings.evidence: Runtime confirmed 2 nodes on 2 pages; axe label. https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.13/label?application=playwright Selector ['#fileupload']. Runtime /admin/images/multiple/add/ and /admin/documents/multiple/add/: axe label flags #fileupload. Adjacent button text is not programmatically associated. Document template also has the input at line 26.

findings.summary: Form-submission selection checkboxes have no names, so screen-reader users cannot identify the select-all control or selected record.
findings.fix: Label the header checkbox “Select all submissions” and label each row checkbox “Select submission …” with a meaningful row identifier, using labels or aria-label.
findings.evidence: Runtime confirmed 2 nodes on 1 pages; axe label. https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.13/label?application=playwright Selector ['input[data-action="w-bulk#toggleAll"]']. Runtime /admin/forms/submissions/69/: axe label flags header checkbox data-w-bulk-target=all and row checkbox name=selected-submissions; source lines 12 and 24 contain no labels.

findings.summary: Tag-it replaces the labeled tag field with an unnamed text input.
findings.fix: After tag-it initializes, give its generated input an ID and associate the existing Tags label with it, or copy the field label through aria-labelledby; also preserve relevant descriptions and invalid state.
findings.evidence: Runtime confirmed 4 nodes on 4 pages; axe label. https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.13/label?application=playwright Selector ['.ui-autocomplete-input']. Runtime /admin/images/51/, /admin/documents/edit/2/, /admin/pages/68/edit/ and /admin/pages/77/edit/: axe label flags .ui-autocomplete-input. vendor/tag-it.js:130 creates <input type=text> without an ID/name association; TagController.connect does not supply one.

findings.summary: Sidebar navigation and account disclosures announce a menu popup although their opened content has ordinary list/link semantics.
findings.fix: Remove aria-haspopup="menu" from SubMenuItem and the account button in MainMenu.tsx:279; retain the accurate aria-expanded disclosure state. Optionally add aria-controls with a stable panel ID. Keep native navigation lists and links.
findings.evidence: Captured admin DOM: Settings/Reports/Help buttons have aria-haspopup="menu"; panels contain h2 and ul > li > a without role="menu". Account button likewise opens ul containing ordinary links.

findings.summary: Legacy chooser dialogs lack an accessible name and do not expose their modal state, leaving background content exposed to assistive technology.
findings.fix: Give the chooser dialog aria-labelledby pointing to its loaded heading (with a unique stable ID) and aria-modal="true", updating the relationship on workflow body replacement. Prefer migrating this Bootstrap branch to the existing labelled a11y-dialog component or native showModal dialog.
findings.evidence: Chromium image/page/document chooser probes: role="dialog", aria-hidden="false", aria-label=null, aria-labelledby=null, aria-modal=null, headings #header-title present. No background aria-hidden or inert. raw/modal-runtime.json.

findings.summary: Tab past the last chooser control moves focus outside the modal, where Escape no longer dismisses it.
findings.fix: Implement explicit Tab and Shift+Tab wrapping between the first and last focusable controls, including document-boundary cases, and handle Escape while the dialog is open. Migrating the shell to the existing a11y-dialog implementation or a native modal dialog can provide these behaviors.
findings.evidence: Chromium image chooser: focus final visible button/input/select/textarea/a; Tab gives document.activeElement=body outside .modal. Escape then leaves .modal.in open. Bootstrap enforces only focusin and binds keyup Escape to .modal. raw/modal-focus.json.

findings.summary: Image focal areas cannot be created or resized using the keyboard.
findings.fix: Expose labelled coordinate and size inputs or implement a focusable crop widget with keyboard create, move and resize actions; keep hidden model fields synchronized and provide a single-pointer alternative to dragging.
findings.evidence: At /admin/images/51/, focus .jcrop-keymgr and press ArrowRight, ArrowDown, Space, Enter: all four hidden coordinates remain empty, selection w/h remain 0. Jcrop keyboard handler only moves an existing rectangle; no resize/create keys.

findings.summary: The focal-point chooser receives keyboard focus in an offscreen radio input with no visible focus indicator.
findings.fix: Provide a visible, focusable focal-area control and draw an obvious focus indicator on the displayed image/widget when keyboard focus enters.
findings.evidence: Runtime .jcrop-keymgr is type=radio with position:fixed;left:-120px;width:12px. Keyboard focus stays on this offscreen input after arrow keys and there is no visible selection for images without a focal area.

findings.summary: Bulk-selection totals change visually without a programmatic status announcement.
findings.fix: Maintain a persistent polite status region outside the initially hidden footer and update it with the selected-item total, including deselection to zero. Preserve checkbox focus and avoid announcing every row in a select-all operation.
findings.evidence: Browser: /admin/images/, /admin/users/, /admin/pages/60/ first-checkbox selection changes span[data-bulk-action-num-objects] to “1 image/user/page selected”. Only live region is unrelated empty .messages. includes/bulk-actions.js:158 changes plain span textContent.

findings.summary: Sortable listings and form submissions expose the current sort column and direction only through visual classes and arrows.
findings.fix: Set aria-sort="ascending" or "descending" on the currently sorted th based on is_ascending/is_descending; clear it on other headers. Do the same using heading.order in wagtailforms/list_submissions.html. Preserve link titles describing the next action.
findings.evidence: 20 archived table pages contain active teal/ordered arrow classes and no aria-sort. /admin/sites/: ascending Site class icon-arrow-up-after, title says “Sort by Site in descending order” (next action). Form submissions: ordered icon-arrow-down-after only.
findings.component: Shared sortable table column headers and form submissions

findings.summary: Empty form controls have low-contrast boundaries in both light and dark themes.
findings.fix: Increase border-field-default to at least 3:1 against field and surrounding page surfaces in both themes; retain separate inactive styling. Apply to controls whose empty editable extent is identified by their border.
findings.evidence: On /admin/users/new/ username, first/last name and password fields: light border #c8c8c8 against white field/content =1.67:1; dark border #5c5c5c against #262626 field/content =2.26:1. Empty fields have no contrasting fill or other extent indicator.

findings.summary: The editor header requires horizontal scrolling to reach the Live-page control at 320 CSS pixels.
findings.fix: Allow the header status/action strip to wrap or move secondary actions into an accessible disclosure at narrow widths, so all controls fit within320px without horizontal scrolling.
findings.evidence: Settled desktop-to320px resize on /admin/pages/69/edit/: status/action strip clientWidth320,scrollWidth368; Live-page link x306,right360.45. Its text and right edge are outside the viewport until the strip scrolls; document also requires vertical scrolling.

passed: All100 sampled admin pages returned HTTP200 and completed axe-core4.13 WCAG A/AA scans in Chromium152.

WCAG-tagged axe checked applicable ARIA validity, permitted attributes, roles and relationships; native form/link/button naming, list structure and table associations. Confirmed exceptions are correlated to canonical findings.
All100 pages have first25Tab samples and320px/text-spacing measurements; these are bounded observations, not complete keyboard or responsive conformance tests.
25 pages underwent41 expanded tab/dropdown-state scans; overlap-induced dashboard target-size candidates were reviewed and excluded.
Targeted runtime tests verified dashboard skip link, existing drag-reordering alternatives, chooser Escape within dialogs, shared privacy dialog name/modality and sidebar PageExplorer dismissal.
notes: Scored runtime findings reuse the exact canonical rule and file:line so rendering can deduplicate them; source-only defects are deliberately absent.
43 initial node candidates remain preserved in raw/runtime-correlation.json and individual runtime files. Multiple nodes can share one component finding.
Image URL scroll-container axe warning was disproved by actual Tab focus in Chromium152; Firefox/Safari behavior remains untested.
Inactive chooser title contrast is excluded; ordinary disabled-row metadata contrast is retained separately.
Expanded dashboard target-size failures were popup-overlap artifacts and are not scored.
Settled suspect table/report widths stay in local scrollers; no data-table reflow failure inferred. Editor non-table toolbar overflow is separately confirmed.
No screenshots, screen-reader audible-output tests, persisted writes, successful POST flows or full100-page keyboard journeys were performed.
Static archive coverage limits include missing Handsontable and fileupload validation assets and unavailable editing-session pings.
raw/runtime-correlation.json maps each initial axe node to its accepted canonical finding or exclusion reason and records aggregate passing rule IDs.
